productionMethod: Original procedural mesh modelling in connected Blender MCP; AI-assisted construction script. No photographic planes, image textures, external image downloads or generative 3D service.

rights.sourceConditions: Photo-informed appearance references are CC BY-SA 4.0 with the attribution above. No source photograph pixels are baked into exported assets. Preserve credits, modification notes and share-alike conditions when reusing photo-informed assets.
rights.copyrightNotice: See recorded original photo creators and source rights; original generated model components do not assert documentary truth.
rights.modifications: Simplified geometry, fictional dimensions/floors, original glazing/roof/entrance details, generic clothing/props, matte material palette, rendering and thumbnail conversion.

renderReview.camera: Shared orthographic camera, +X/-Y/+Z three-quarter direction; 768px proof output, 512px WebP thumbnail.
renderReview.lighting: Shared broad key/fill area lights, soft sun and skylight. Website light levels are reviewed separately with the actual MapLibre camera.
revisions: Corrected apartment-block side-wall glazing outward orientation.
Bent cyclist legs and arms into a grounded riding pose; adjusted porter hands to the parcel.
Replaced large single foliage blobs with 28 varied canopy clusters.
Softened people into tapered tailored garment shapes and smoother anonymous heads.
renderReview.status: All exported geometry and thumbnail silhouettes visually reviewed; runtime integration/lighting review is tracked by the app implementation.
renderReview.sourceValidation: Saved .blend reopened successfully in Blender 5.2 background mode using the installed application executable; both Scene and NORTH_Pyongyang_Diorama are present, original Camera/Light retained, production has 13 asset collections and one review-studio collection.

performance.gzipNote: Measured locally with Node zlib default gzip. Actual CDN transfer depends on hosting content-encoding.

spatialLimits: No surveyed footprint coordinates are encoded in reusable GLBs. Existing reviewed map geometry remains the spatial authority. The three-tower composition uses mapped centers at runtime; generic block/store modules must not replace unmatched real footprints.
periodLimits: Reference photo dates are 2018 or 2019. Assets shared across the 2015–2019 scenario are visual reconstructions, not newly observed facts for every selected year.
